Classify medical devices

classify_medical_devices.Rd

Uses an ellmer Chat object (e.g., ellmer::chat_google_gemini() or ellmer::chat_ollama()) to screen and classify unique device_name entries:

  • Is a device: Flags whether each item is a true medical device ("yes" or "no"), excluding non-device dm+d products such as creams, pharmaceuticals, and nutritional feeds.

  • Regulatory: Assigns true medical devices to an EU/UK MDR risk class (Class I, Class IIa, Class IIb, or Class III).

  • Medical speciality: Assigns true medical devices to an EU/UK MDR risk class (Anesthesiology, Cardiovascular, Chemistry, Dental, Ear, Nose, and Throat (ENT), Gastroenterology and Urology, General and Plastic Surgery, General Hospital, Hematology, Immunology, Neurology, Obstetrical and Gynecological, Ophthalmic, Orthopedic, Pathology, Physical Medicine, Radiology, Toxicology).

Usage

classify_medical_devices(
  chat,
  data,
  max_retries = 3L,
  batch_size = 20L,
  show_cost = TRUE
)

Arguments

chat

An ellmer Chat object (such as from ellmer::chat_openai(model = "gpt-4o-mini") or ellmer::chat_ollama(model = "qwen2.5:7b", api_args = list(temperature = 0))).

data

A data.frame or tibble containing a device_name column.

max_retries

Integer scalar. Maximum number of attempts for any concept before returning NA_character_. Defaults to 3L.

batch_size

Integer scalar. Number of unique device names to classify per LLM request. Defaults to 20L.

show_cost

Logical scalar. Whether to track and display cumulative API costs via chat$get_cost() during execution. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

A tibble with the original rows and columns of data, plus:

  • is_medical_device: Character ("yes", "no", or NA_character_).

  • device_class: Character ("Class I", "Class IIa", "Class IIb", "Class III", or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).

  • medical_specialty: Character (one of the 17 standard medical specialties, or NA_character_ if not a device or failed).
